ink.rule: max(R,G,B) < 100, not within 2 px of a filled coloured blob

tape_pink.game_rule: one tap on any bundled arrow sends the whole bundle if every ray is clear (L32 x4, L38, L44)

door.rule: blob area > 2.5 pitch^2, >25% blue (B>200,R<160,G>120) and >2% purple
door.game_rule: blocks rays; opened (shatters) by a key; hides arrows

key.rule: blob area < 3 pitch^2 with >15% gold and >3% purple (ring)
key.game_rule: when its arrow leaves, the key flies to the next locked door (L33: leftmost/lowest first) and opens it

pipe.rule: blob >25% blue with <=2% purple (tube + rims + counter; rims/counter pieces re-merged by label_blobs)
pipe.game_rule: a ray entering a mouth against its outward direction continues out of the other mouth; counter -1 per passage; at 0 the pipe shatters

unknown.action: bot stops before the first tap / pauses mid-level

box.rule: blob area > 2.5 pitch^2, >30% purple (R>110,B>170,G<110), <10% blue; blobs inside its bbox (silver counter ring, digits, bolts) = box_part
box.game_rule: L50 unlock 'Box! Unlocked!' / 'Clear required amount of arrows to break the BOX!': counter = arrows still to clear; bot treats its cells as blocking (like a door) until it breaks

red_arrow.rule: R>150, R-G>80, |G-B|<50, G<140 (+ its anti-aliased rim) = ink
red_arrow.game_rule: a BUMPED arrow turns red (238,10,19) and stays red; still a normal arrow
